questions.explanation: Keynes was most concerned with demand pull inflation occurs when aggregate demand for goods and services exceeds aggregate supply. It happen when the overall demand in an economy outpaces its productive capacity. Keynes was particularly focused on demand management, policies, such as fiscal and monetary measures, to address economic issues, including demand, pull inflation.
